honeywellMvpBoundary: Honeywell MVP review only. This packet is NOT broad Cisco-general approval. It approves no optic, no replacement candidate, no pricing authority, and no silent runtime SKU substitution. Every entry stays pending_human_approval and recommendedDecision is advisory only.
sequencingNote: Batch 4 here is the remaining-review batch: the 2 optics and the 11 historical-to-current replacement candidates that approved Batch 1, Batch 2, and Batch 3 intentionally left deferred. No approved Batch 4 runtime pack exists or is created here; optics and replacement candidates remain deferred and no silent runtime SKU substitution is modeled.
notes: REVIEW-ONLY Batch 4 optics / replacement-candidate review packet. It is not runtime authority and is not an approved rule pack. Every entry stays pending_human_approval; recommendedDecision is advisory only and approves, activates, and runtime-enables nothing. No approved Batch 4 runtime pack is created by this packet, and no runtime evaluator, pricing, catalog, API, UI, DB, or export behavior is added. Configuration authority (what to add/default/offer) stays strictly separate from pricing authority; this packet carries no pricing fields. The approved Batch 1 pack (honeywell-batch1-approved-rules), Batch 2 pack (honeywell-batch2-approved-rules), and Batch 3 pack (honeywell-batch3-approved-rules) are already approved and are unchanged by this packet. The source v2 candidate pack (honeywell-candidate-rules-v2) and v2 approval packet (honeywell-rule-approval-packet-v2) remain candidate/pending. Optics are NOT approved here. Replacement candidates are separate historical-to-current review decisions and authorize NO silent runtime SKU substitution. Evidence with GPL or catalog references is SKU existence/description evidence only, not pricing or configuration authority.
